Sally Thirtytwo is 8 years old. Sally Four is the same age as Sally Thirtytwo, so Sally Four is also 8. Granny Red is two times as old as Sally Four, so Granny Red is 16. Sally Two is three years older than Granny Red, so Sally Two is 19. The total age of the four birds is 19 + 16 + 8 + 8 = 51.

Answer: 51
